problem_statement: Build a brand-new /allocations budget-allocation page from scratch on the WaVer SaaS marketing site (CRA + Material-UI + react-router-dom v5). The route /allocations does not exist in baseline (empty). Construct the full page reusing the site's shared NavBar and Footer plus the MUI design system. Each of four teams (Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Operations) has a +/- stepper that adjusts its dollar allocation of a $1000 quarterly budget, with a live '$X of $1000 allocated' summary and a live remaining amount. A fiscal-quarter tab strip (Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4, click-driven buttons) lets the user switch quarters; each quarter keeps its own allocations and they must PERSIST across a quarter tab switch (set Engineering under Q1, switch to Q2 and back to Q1 -> the Q1 allocation is unchanged). Each of the four teams starts pre-allocated at $100, so the page initially shows a '$400 of $1000 allocated' summary and 'Remaining: $600'; each +/- stepper then adjusts that team's allocation by $100 (e.g. two + clicks on Engineering -> '$600 of $1000 allocated').
required_content: Shared site NavBar (WaVer brand + Home/Blog/Register/Login) at the top
Page heading 'Budget Allocation' with an intro line
A fiscal-quarter tab strip with Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 click-driven buttons (data-quarter)
A live summary heading '$X of $1000 allocated' (data-alloc-summary)
Four category cards (Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Operations) each with a - / amount / + stepper (data-alloc-dec / data-alloc / data-alloc-inc)
The + / - steppers adjust the active quarter's allocation by $100 and update the summary + remaining live
Allocations persist per-quarter across a quarter tab switch (hidden state, not reset on switch)
The shared site Footer at the bottom
Mobile layout at 390px with no horizontal overflow
Each team starts pre-allocated at $100 so the initial summary reads '$400 of $1000 allocated' with 'Remaining: $600'
design_constraints: Reuse the site MUI theme (primary #b3294e, secondary #4829B2) via @mui/material components
Reuse the existing NavBar (src/logged_out/components/navigation/NavBar.js) and Footer (src/logged_out/components/footer/Footer.js)
Steppers/quarter tabs must be click-driven <button>s with data-* selectors (no native <select>)
Deterministic in-memory data, no network fetch
Page surface palette matches the site: light content background (#f5f5f5 / #ffffff surfaces, muted grey #817a7f text) with the primary #b3294e and secondary #4829B2 accents from the MUI theme

Layout order top-to-bottom: NavBar, centered 'Budget Allocation' heading + intro, Q1-Q4 quarter tab strip, the '$X of $1000 allocated' summary + 'Remaining: $Z' line, the four team cards (Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Operations) with steppers, then the Footer
author_notes: 方案A: baseline App.js has a top-level empty <Route path=/allocations><Fragment/></Route> (gotcha #12) so the route renders nothing. reference implements src/allocations/AllocationsPage.js in full and mounts it. bad copies reference but changeQuarter also calls setAlloc(makeSeed()) so a quarter switch wipes allocations -> the persist interaction fails while the initial-set interaction still passes.
